_meta.io.skavio/authentication: Agent Tools Bearer API key. Operation availability and admission are checked by the customer backend.

error.description: Explicit failure code; no success/delivery implied.

io.skavio/result-schema.description: PaymentRequired, durable job admission, or explicit error. Admission is not delivery; poll owned status then result and verify SHA256.

description: Retrieve content from a public HTTPS document under robots.txt, SSRF and byte limits. Use for a source fetch; choose web_extract when only human-visible text is needed and web_monitor for content change hashes. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backend operation and an accepted payment mode. x402 returns a workload-specific quote and prepaid consumes shared company credits. Retry with the SAME idempotency_key and inputs to recover, not a new job. Admission is not delivery: poll skavio_agent_job_status, retrieve through skavio_agent_job_result, and verify SHA256. No anonymous execution.

arguments.description: Tool-specific structured input object. Supply the required named fields described by its JSON Schema; source bytes must respect encoded size limits. Never include wallet private keys, passwords or API tokens.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Robots, public address and bounded response checks apply.

idempotency_key.description: Stable job key; retry exactly the same inputs and payment mode with this key to recover safely.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

payment_mode.description: x402 returns a workload-specific quote; prepaid spends your existing shared company credits. No anonymous execution.
payment_mode.title: Payment Mode

name: web_fetch
title: Web fetch
